rows.en: Gel-Shocker?
Hmph… Do you think changing your name will make you any stronger?
Kukuku…
…!? Who are you?
I have come all the way from the African desert to organize Gel-Shocker's Japan Branch. Remember me as General Black!
General Black, you say?

Shocker has taken in the power of Gelderm and the Battle Fleet Nation Naager, and been reborn as Gel-Shocker!

Gel-Shocker will rule the Earth without fail… and to that end we will use murder, riots, destruction, every evil there is…
But as long as we're around, even if Gelderm has shown up now, it'll meet the same fate as Shocker.

What!?

Under General Black's command, Gel-Shocker will spread terror across all of Japan… no, across the whole world!

Even if I have to drag you down with me, Takeshi Hongo, Hayato Ichimonji, I won't let you get in the way! Prepare yourselves!!
Uoooooh!!
Uoooooh!!
Uoooooh!!
Uoooooh!!
Kukukuku… Kikaider, today I destroy you for sure!!
Stop it, Hakaider! I can't fight you!!
Stop it, Hakaider! I cannot fight you!!
Stop, Hakaider! As long as Dr. Komyoji's brain is inside your head, I can't fight!
Stop, Hakaider! As long as Dr. Komyoji's brain is inside your head, I cannot fight!
That's your problem! I can't be bothered with anything except destroying you!!
Kuh… I got careless… But I'll pay you back for this, mark my words!!
Ugh!! D-damn it! I have to replace the blood for the brain… I was just one step away, dammit…
Kamen Rider's been killed…
Hayato…
Hongo…
Ichimonji…
Hongo won't die! No way he'd die! He'll come back any minute now, as healthy as ever.
Ichimonji won't die! No way he'd die! He'll come back any minute now, as healthy as ever.

That's right!

Nobody's said for certain that he's dead! There's still hope!

Listen… even if, just maybe, Takeshi really is dead, we have to keep on fighting! Everyone, pull yourselves together!

That's right…

Even if, just maybe, Hayato really is dead, we have to keep on fighting! Everyone, pull yourselves together!

Oyassan's right!

From now on, those of us who are left will fight the evil organizations for peace and justice: the terrifying Gel-Shocker, DARK and Makuu! Come on, cheer up…
Hayato…
Hongo…
With the destruction of Shocker's Japan Branch, the warriors learned of the threat of the newly born Gel-Shocker, and fatigue and unease showed on their faces.
A battle with no end in sight. A peace that showed no sign of coming… A dark shadow spread across the warriors' hearts.
Kamen Rider 1 and Ganikomol struck each other down, and he vanished in a ball of fire!
Kamen Rider 2 and Ganikomol struck each other down, and he vanished in a ball of fire!
Defeat the executive monster Garagaranda!
Defeat all executive monsters and Shocker Combatants!
Defeat the executive monster Ganikomol!
Defeat all executive monsters and Shocker Combatants! Also seize the laboratory, the factory and the power plant!
Defeat Ika-Devil, Garagaranda and Gigant!
Takeshi Hongo or Hayato Ichimonji is defeated
<c3>Den Iga</c>'s Morale went <c2>UP</c>!
<c3>Den Iga</c>'s Morale went <c1>DOWN</c>!
If you're gonna do it, then get it over with!!
Don't jump to conclusions… I've come to take you out of here.
Whaaat?
I have brought Doubleman, the prisoner serving a life sentence.

Doubleman… You may choose one of two paths!

One… you go on living in the underground stone cell as before.

The other: defeat Space Sheriff Gavan and win your freedom. And if you manage to defeat Gavan… I will make you a top executive.

So for a souvenir… this Gavan's head will do, right?

I know a way to beat Gavan. Give me the power of a Monster! Then I'll win for sure!

I see…

Fuse Doubleman with a Monster to create a Double Monster… What a groundbreaking idea! Use the bio-fusion device at once!
Retsu Ichijouji, otherwise known as Space Sheriff Gavan, was receiving an interstellar transmission from Commander Kom of Planet Bird aboard his mothership, the Dolgiran.
Gavan… You know of the Space Crime Secret Society "Madou", don't you?

Yes…

I hear it's a band of evil espers led by the almighty psychic "Demon King Psycho"… Has something happened with Madou?
It seems they've begun an invasion of Earth.
What!? We haven't even arrested Makuu yet, and now Madou's coming to Earth too?

Yes, and that's why… I've decided to dispatch a new Space Sheriff.

Let me introduce him… the one who'll be in charge of the Earth sector from now on: Space Sheriff Sharivan!
I'm Sharivan! Thanks for what you did for me that time…

Y-you're… the guy from the Forest Patrol?

I see… So you became a Space Sheriff?
I'm really grateful! You saved me when I was in a tight spot…
Ah, it was nothing… But this is great! Now we've got one more comrade.
I'll do my best!

Yeah…

But Commander Kom… I'm the sheriff in charge of the Earth sector! Me, Gavan.
You've been promoted to captain of the Galactic Patrol!
The Galactic Patrol?
You'll be looking after not just Earth, but the entire solar system!
Huh…
Congratulations, Gavan…
Isn't that wonderful?
Y-yeah…
I'll be in your care from now on too! Captain!!
C-Captain?
He means you, Gavan…

Oh, right, that's me…

I'm counting on you, Sharivan!
Yes, Captain!!
So that's how it is… One more comrade is coming to Earth!
A Space Sheriff getting more subordinates. How very impressive…

Hey, Hayato… There's no need to talk like that, is there?

Sorry, Retsu… He's on edge because there's been no word of Takeshi, see? Sorry about that.
No, it's all right…

Even so… Now even Madou is invading Earth.

The science crime syndicate Makuu, and now the evil esper band Madou… That's a little too neat to be mere coincidence. Is Naager pulling the strings after all?

uncertain: U02897: Hongo says Gelderm (not Gel-Shocker) will meet Shocker's fate; translated as written.
U02911: やられた read as 'killed' given the following lines about whether he is dead.
U02924/U02925: 'he' = the Rider; the Rider and Ganikomol both fell, but the line says the Rider vanished.
U02926/U02928: garbled 幹一夢在 read as 幹部怪人 (executive monster) by analogy with U02927.
U02942/U02943: ［マドー］ and ［魔王サイコ］ rendered with double quotes.
U02958/U02962: Mimi lines; 'He means you' in U02962 refers to Den calling Gavan Captain.
U02966: Hayato's line read as sarcastic (he is grieving Hongo).

new_names.why: not in glossary; standard English name of the Kamen Rider organization
not in glossary as a standalone key; glossary notes use 'Madō' but ō is not in the font
not in glossary standalone; matches 'DARK Robot'
